overall: The AG found the Rowley Board of Water Commissioners violated the Open Meeting Law by entering executive session at its September 11, 2015 meeting without a valid purpose, relying on OML 2016-21 and resolving the complaint by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board entered executive session at its September 11, 2015 meeting without a valid statutory purpose.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated in that determination, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.
